content_ops_procedures.content: Content-Ops Procedures v2.3 (effective 2026-01-15). 1) Assets within 60 days of expiration are 'expiring soon' and must be flagged to their owner. 2) Assets expiring within 14 days are 'urgent' and require an escalation line in the alert plus CC to the Content Lead (Sofia Mendez). 3) Alert subject line format: '[Action Needed] Assets expiring before <date>'. 4) Each alert must list Asset ID, Title, and Expiration Date verbatim. 5) Owners decide whether to renew, update, or archive; content-ops does not change asset Status without owner confirmation.

Reply to this thread with your decision, or reach out to content-ops with questions. Thanks, Content Operations.'
